cover.bottom: GOING THROUGH 5 STAGES ON THE WAY TO LEGEND STATUS

photo.prompt: five stylish friends laughing outside a neon-lit South Beach club at 2am, one holding up a phone with a rideshare map, palm trees glowing pink, party lights spilling onto the sidewalk

slides.headline: You Say Dinner Is The Whole Plan
slides.body: Then Brickell starts glowing and suddenly everyone is checking who’s nearby on NEAR.

photo.prompt: four friends at an outdoor Brickell restaurant table at night, skyline lights behind them, one friend showing NEAR on their phone while everyone leans in laughing

slides.headline: You Choose The Bar By The Line
slides.body: Wynwood has three doors, two crowds, and you somehow pick the one that looks famous.

photo.prompt: a packed Wynwood bar entrance at night with colorful murals, a confident friend pointing at the shorter line while the group follows, neon reflections on the sidewalk

slides.headline: You Find The Loudest Corner
slides.body: One song in and your table turns into the unofficial reunion for everyone you know.

photo.prompt: a lively corner table inside a Miami lounge, friends cheering and waving more people over, blue and purple club lights, phones out capturing the moment

slides.headline: You Vanish To The Rooftop View
slides.body: Brickell skyline hits and now everyone needs a photo like the night has sponsors.

photo.prompt: two friends posing on a Brickell rooftop at midnight with skyscrapers behind them, one friend crouched taking the perfect flash photo, city lights sparkling

slides.headline: You Make Sunrise Sound Reasonable
slides.body: 3:12am, safe ride booked, someone says beach tomorrow, and nobody says no fast enough.

photo.prompt: a friend group outside a Miami late-night food spot at 3am, warm streetlights, takeout bags in hand, one person holding up a phone with a safe ride arriving

caption: tag the friend who turns one dinner into all five stages 🌴
